options.name: endpoint
options.description: Endpoint to use to connect to API. Do not change until specifically asked to do otherwise. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_URL) environment variable is used.

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels to attach to the instance. If labels do not exist they will be created. Key-value pairs. More info at https://developers.servers.com/api-documentation/v1/#section/Labels.

options.name: location_group_id
options.description: ID of location group to create L2 segment Used only for I(state)=C(absent) or I(State)=C(present) If members are in different location group than specified, module fails.

options.name: members
options.description: List of servers and mode of connection (native or trunk) (Either I(members) or I(members_present) or I(members_absent) required if I(state)=C(present) L2 segment should contains at least one member Server can be member of only one L2 segment in I(mode)=C(native) Server can participate in multiple L2 segments in I(mode)=C(trunk) Server can be present in a given segment only once (e.g. it's impossible to have the same segment with two different vlan IDs on the same server) L2 segment is reconfigur

options.name: members_absent
options.description: List of servers to be absent in L2 segment Other servers in L2 segement are not affected (this option only assure that listed servers are removed) (Either I(members) or I(members_present) or I(members_absent) required if I(state)=C(present) L2 segment should contains at least two members Either I(members) or I(members_present) can be used. Either I(members) or I(members_absent) can be used.

options.name: members_present
options.description: List of servers and mode of connection (native or trunk) Existing servers in L2 segement are not affected, except for possible mode change (this option only assure that servers are added) (Either I(members) or I(members_present) or I(members_absent) required if I(state)=C(present) L2 segment should contains at least one member Server can be member of only one L2 segment in I(mode)=C(native) Server can participate in multiple L2 segments in I(mode)=C(trunk) Server can be present in a given segmen

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the segment This module required to all segments to have unique names If two segments have the same name (even in different location groups or having different type), this module fails. Either I(name) or I(segment_id) is required for delete/update of existing segment. I(name) is required if new segment need to be created

options.name: segment_id
options.description: ID of the segment Can be used for delete or update operations istead if I(name)

options.name: state
options.description: State of the segment C(absent) make sure that segment was deleted If C(absent), and I(type) is specified, delete segment of only given type. If C(absent) and I(type) is not specified delete segment of any type.

options.name: token
options.description: Token to use. You can create token for your account in https://portal.servers.com in Profile -> Public API section. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) or C(SC_TOKEN) environment variable is used (C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) takes precedence). Value is not logged.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of segment Required if I(state)=C(present) Global Private Network is C(private) Internet is C(public)s If I(type) for existing segment is different, module fails.

options.name: update_interval
options.description: Interval for polling for of L2 segment Each update consumes API quota. Ignored if I(wait)=C(0)

options.name: wait
options.description: Max wait time for operation to be finished. By default waiting for L2 segment to become active. C(0) disable waiting (fire-and-forget mode)
